title: High-yield synthesis of heavy rare earth(III) anhydrous solvates: known, new, and unexpected products

material_class.structural_family: tetranuclear Gd4 peroxide chloride thf solvate

synthesis.procedure: All manipulations were carried out under N2 using Schlenk and glovebox techniques. Complex 12 formed serendipitously during a repetition of the synthesis of polymeric [{GdCl(μ-Cl)2(thf)2}∞] (2). For 2, GdCl3·6H2O (1.15 g, 3.09 mmol) was dehydrated analogously to 1 in Pr^iOH with teof, then dried under vacuum, washed with hexane (2 × 15 mL), and evaporated to dryness. THF (10.0 mL) was added, stirred at room temperature, and evaporated; a further 20.0 mL of thf was added and mild heating at 35 °C gave a clear solution that was cooled to −20 °C. After 24 h, microcrystalline 2 (0.91 g) was isolated by filtration. The recovered mother liquor was cooled again to −20 °C; after 13 days, ca. 20 mg of colorless block crystals of 12 formed. Crystals became powdery after solvent removal. Single-crystal X-ray data were collected at 100(2) K from a crystal taken directly from the mother liquor. The small amount of product prevented full characterization. Formation of the μ3-peroxide is ascribed to redox incorporation of O2^{2−}.

reagents.name: triethyl orthoformate
reagents.amount: same dehydration process as for 1 (9.0 mL, 54 mmol teof used for 4.30 mmol Gd in 1; scaled analogously, exact teof volume for this 3.09 mmol batch not restated)

synthesis.temperature: room temperature then 35 °C for dissolution of 2; crystallization of 12 at −20 °C; SCXRD at 100(2) K
synthesis.time: 24 h isolation of 2; mother liquor held 13 days at −20 °C for 12
synthesis.vessel_or_method: Schlenk/glovebox; N2 atmosphere; cooling crystallization from thf mother liquor of 2
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: After isolation of microcrystalline 2 by filtration, the recovered thf mother liquor was recooled to −20 °C; colorless blocks of 12 formed after 13 days and were taken from the mother solution for diffraction to avoid desolvation.
synthesis.yield: ca. 20 mg (low yield; not fully characterized)

properties.summary: No magnetic or optical measurements are reported for 12; magnetism in the article is discussed only for Dy complexes 6 and 9. Crystal color (colorless) is not treated as an optical property.
